hypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the predeclared ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations satisfy both the same-size improvement and gas-safety rules, or if valid quotes are unavailable. A pass is not acceptance or profit. Preserve the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate. Unknown extra gas, infrastructure costs, and unreconciled model-invoice costs preclude a full-profit claim.
hypotheses.name: PONS–USDG triangle same-size quote-improvement probe
hypotheses.rationale: Measured fact: the verified graph contains WETH-linked PONS and USDG pools, and the menu offers this route at exactly 0.005 WETH with QUOTE_IMPROVEMENT. Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: at that exact size, amount out may improve by at least 100 bps versus the previous consecutive source-valid quote while the current net edge covers the configured gas-safety requirement. The first source-valid quote cannot signal; both conditions must hold for two consecutive eligible observations. Cohort observations include blocks 97430295 and 97583762, but they do not validate this forward route/size cell or establish an edge.

limitations: Training observations are not forward validation; quote opportunities are not fills, trades, inclusion, or earned returns.
The bounded graph and deterministic menu are not complete chain coverage; the menu offers no route using a token outside WETH, USDG, PONS, and CASHCAT.
No live strategy change, signing, deployment, or new strategy code is authorized.
Unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model-invoice costs prevent full-profit claims.
analysis.summary: The supplied cohort contains 80 observations and 480 quotes, but does not identify route-specific forward results for the proposed cell. The prior trial memory reports several rejected no-signal screens; those outcomes do not validate this new experiment. The menu contains no route using a token outside WETH, USDG, PONS, and CASHCAT, so a new-token route cannot be selected from the available cells. This is a paper experiment only; retain the original control and the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate.
